## Requirements (contract)

1. **D-P30.4-4 per Q7 = (a)** — narrow the check to code + config (explicit include list; `docs/build/`,
   `docs/tickets/`, `docs/adr/` excluded with the reason), record in ADR-R9-LEAKSCOPE, arm in CI, verify
   armed. No redaction of append-only records.
2. Verify every Round-9 closure DONE with live evidence, or keep it honestly OPEN.
3. A "P31.19 sweep" table (P30.4 format) — every remaining OPEN/PARTIAL row with owner, precise blocker,
   landing.
4. Whole-build capstone: `make check`, `make test-db`, `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 uv run pytest tests/e2e`,
   `check_coverage_matrix.py`, `check-build-memory.sh` — all green, dated report.
5. `D-P31.4-1`: before 2026-10-10 the row stays OPEN with its exact verify command; never a pre-dated
   green.
6. `projectStatus` per BM-TAIL-03, stating plainly whether a not-yet-seeded Round-10 landing satisfies
   the rule.
7. Close the ticket: LEDGER CURRENT STATE + PHASE LOG entry, BUILD_INDEX row 160, run ledger, PR body,
   `check-build-memory.sh` green.

## Plan

Branch off the P31.16 tip. Rewrite `test_gcp_project_id_is_env_resolved_not_committed` around an explicit
`_PROJECT_ID_SCOPE` include list (every §47 package `src/`, `db` sqitch surfaces, `ontology/vocab` +
`ontology/generated`, `ops/`, `web/`, `tests/`, `scripts/`, `.github/`, root + package build/deploy/CI
config) instead of "every tracked file"; `docs/` (build memory, tickets, ADRs) is exempt. Write ADR-119,
feed it to Appendix F, regenerate spec + index + BL-057 sources, arm the step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
off `vars.SIG_GCP_PROJECT` (skips unset). Verify armed + negative control. Sweep + annotate DEFERRALS.
Run the capstone, write the dated report, close out the ledger/index/phase log.
